title: Independent life
description: German for expressing ideas, pursuing goals, and discussing the world around you.

chapters.title: Independent life
chapters.description: Explain opinions, discuss professional goals, and understand everyday news.

lessons.title: Sharing opinions
lessons.summary: State a viewpoint, acknowledge another perspective, and disagree respectfully.
lessons.heroTitle: Make your point without closing the conversation.
lessons.completionTitle: You can express and balance an opinion.
objectives: Agree or disagree in a respectful way

sentences.text: Meiner Meinung nach ist die Idee sinnvoll.
sentences.translation: In my opinion, the idea makes sense.
sentences.note: Meiner Meinung nach is a neutral way to introduce a personal view.

sentences.text: Da stimme ich dir nur teilweise zu.
sentences.translation: I only partly agree with you on that.
sentences.note: Zustimmen takes a dative object, such as dir.

sentences.text: Obwohl es teuer ist, spart es langfristig Energie.
sentences.translation: Although it is expensive, it saves energy in the long term.
sentences.note: The verb goes to the end of the obwohl clause.

sentences.text: Einerseits ist es praktisch, andererseits fehlt der persönliche Kontakt.
sentences.translation: On the one hand it is practical; on the other hand personal contact is missing.
sentences.note: The paired connectors organize two contrasting points.

sentences.text: Ich verstehe deinen Punkt, sehe das aber anders.
sentences.translation: I understand your point, but I see it differently.
sentences.note: This phrase recognizes the other view before disagreeing.

grammar.title: Balancing ideas with obwohl
grammar.explanation: Obwohl introduces a fact that contrasts with the main statement. The conjugated verb goes to the end of the obwohl clause, and the clauses are separated by a comma.

examples.source: Obwohl der Weg lang ist, fahre ich mit dem Rad.
examples.translation: Although the route is long, I cycle.

examples.source: Ich gehe hin, obwohl ich wenig Zeit habe.
examples.translation: I am going, although I have little time.

grammar.commonMistake: Do not keep normal main-clause order after obwohl; the conjugated verb belongs at the end.

lines.speaker: Samira
lines.text: Meiner Meinung nach sollten wir öfter von zu Hause arbeiten.
lines.translation: In my opinion, we should work from home more often.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Einerseits ist das praktisch, andererseits fehlt mir das Team.
lines.translation: On the one hand that is practical; on the other hand I miss the team.

lines.speaker: Samira
lines.text: Das verstehe ich, obwohl wir uns online gut austauschen können.
lines.translation: I understand that, although we can communicate well online.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Da stimme ich dir teilweise zu. Zwei Tage pro Woche wären gut.
lines.translation: I partly agree with you. Two days per week would be good.

questions.explanation: Zustimmen means to agree with someone.

questions.prompt: ___ es teuer ist, ist es sinnvoll.
questions.explanation: Obwohl introduces a contrasting subordinate clause.

questions.prompt: You understand the point but disagree.
choices: Ich verstehe deinen Punkt, sehe das aber anders.
questions.correctAnswer: Ich verstehe deinen Punkt, sehe das aber anders.
questions.explanation: The sentence acknowledges the other person before disagreeing.
Die Meinung means opinion.
The verb goes to the end of the subordinate clause.

questions.prompt: Einerseits ist es praktisch, ___ fehlt der Kontakt.
questions.explanation: Einerseits and andererseits present two sides.
Zustimmen takes the dative pronoun dir and separates in a main clause.
David says that two days per week would be good.

lessons.title: Work and goals
lessons.summary: Describe professional experience, strengths, and plans for development.
lessons.heroTitle: Tell the story behind your next step.
lessons.completionTitle: You can discuss your professional goals.

sentences.text: Ich habe drei Jahre Erfahrung im Kundenservice.
sentences.translation: I have three years of experience in customer service.
sentences.note: Im combines in and dem and introduces the professional area.

sentences.text: Ich suche eine Stelle, die mehr Verantwortung bietet.
sentences.translation: I am looking for a position that offers more responsibility.
sentences.note: Die refers back to the feminine noun Stelle.

sentences.text: Zu meinen Stärken gehört, dass ich zuverlässig bin.
sentences.translation: One of my strengths is that I am reliable.
sentences.note: This structure introduces a strength with a complete dass clause.

sentences.text: Mein Ziel ist es, mich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
sentences.translation: My goal is to develop professionally.
sentences.note: The infinitive group with zu explains the goal.

sentences.text: Deshalb bewerbe ich mich um diese Stelle.
sentences.translation: That is why I am applying for this position.
sentences.note: Sich bewerben um takes the accusative case.

grammar.title: Adding detail with relative clauses
grammar.explanation: A relative clause gives more information about a noun. The relative pronoun matches the noun's gender and case, and the conjugated verb goes to the end.

examples.source: Das ist die Stelle, die mich interessiert.
examples.translation: That is the position that interests me.

examples.source: Ich kenne den Kollegen, der das Team leitet.
examples.translation: I know the colleague who leads the team.

grammar.commonMistake: Choose the relative pronoun from its role inside the relative clause, not only from the noun before it.

lines.speaker: Recruiter
lines.text: Welche Erfahrung bringen Sie mit?
lines.translation: What experience do you bring?

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: Ich habe drei Jahre Erfahrung im Kundenservice.
lines.translation: I have three years of experience in customer service.

lines.speaker: Recruiter
lines.text: Was ist Ihnen bei einer neuen Stelle wichtig?
lines.translation: What is important to you in a new position?

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: Ich suche eine Stelle, die Verantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet.
lines.translation: I am looking for a position that offers responsibility and opportunities for development.

questions.explanation: Zuverlässig describes someone who can be depended on.

questions.prompt: Ich suche eine Stelle, ___ mehr Verantwortung bietet.
questions.explanation: Stelle is feminine and the pronoun is the subject of bietet.

choices: Mein Ziel ist es, mich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
questions.correctAnswer: Mein Ziel ist es, mich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
questions.explanation: The infinitive phrase explains the speaker's goal.
Die Verantwortung means responsibility.
Die is the feminine subject and the verb goes to the end.
Sich bewerben is used with um and the accusative.

questions.prompt: I have three years of experience.
questions.explanation: Erfahrung is the noun used for professional experience.

questions.prompt: Which field did Mina work in?
questions.explanation: Mina mentions three years in customer service.

lessons.title: News that matters
lessons.summary: Understand a short report, identify its source, and discuss its impact.
lessons.heroTitle: Move from the headline to the meaning.
lessons.completionTitle: You can discuss a short news report.
objectives: Identify the source and main claim

sentences.text: Der Bericht wurde gestern veröffentlicht.
sentences.translation: The report was published yesterday.
sentences.note: The past passive uses wurde plus the past participle.

sentences.text: Laut der Quelle nutzen mehr Menschen den Zug.
sentences.translation: According to the source, more people use the train.
sentences.note: Laut introduces the source of information.

sentences.text: Neue Fahrradwege werden gebaut.
sentences.translation: New cycle paths are being built.
sentences.note: The present passive uses werden plus the past participle.

sentences.text: Die Preise steigen, deshalb ändern viele ihre Gewohnheiten.
sentences.translation: Prices are rising, so many people are changing their habits.
sentences.note: Deshalb occupies the first position and the conjugated verb follows it.

sentences.text: Welche Auswirkungen hat diese Entwicklung?
sentences.translation: What impact does this development have?
sentences.note: This open question invites discussion of consequences.

grammar.title: Focusing on events with the passive
grammar.explanation: Use werden plus the past participle when the action or result matters more than the person doing it. The participle appears at the end of the clause.

examples.translation: The report is being published today.

grammar.commonMistake: Do not confuse the passive with the future: the past participle at the end signals the passive action.

lines.speaker: Moderatorin
lines.text: Heute wurde ein neuer Verkehrsbericht veröffentlicht.
lines.translation: A new transport report was published today.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Laut dem Bericht nutzen mehr Menschen Busse und Bahnen.
lines.translation: According to the report, more people use buses and trains.

lines.speaker: Moderatorin
lines.text: Wie reagiert die Stadt?
lines.translation: How is the city responding?

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Neue Fahrradwege werden gebaut. Deshalb sollen weniger Autos ins Zentrum fahren.
lines.translation: New cycle paths are being built. Therefore, fewer cars should drive into the center.

questions.explanation: Die Quelle identifies where information comes from.
The present passive uses werden plus a past participle.

questions.prompt: Die Preise steigen, ___ ändern viele ihre Gewohnheiten.
questions.explanation: Deshalb introduces a consequence.
Der Bericht means report.
Werden plus gebaut forms the present passive.

questions.prompt: therefore many people change their habits
questions.explanation: After deshalb, the conjugated verb comes before the subject.
Laut introduces a cited source.
The report says that new cycle paths are being built.

chapters.title: Learning and participation
chapters.description: Develop new skills, handle disrupted plans, and take an active role in the community.

lessons.title: Learning and development
lessons.summary: Discuss further education, requirements, and concrete learning goals.
lessons.heroTitle: Turn a learning goal into a practical plan.
lessons.completionTitle: You can discuss education and development.
objectives: Describe a course and its requirements
Explain a goal with um ... zu

sentences.text: Ich nehme an einer berufsbegleitenden Weiterbildung teil.
sentences.translation: I am taking part in further training alongside work.
sentences.note: Teilnehmen uses an plus the dative case and separates in a main clause.

sentences.text: Welche Voraussetzungen muss ich erfüllen?
sentences.translation: Which requirements do I have to meet?
sentences.note: Voraussetzungen erfüllen is the standard combination for meeting requirements.

sentences.text: Ich besuche den Kurs, um meine Kenntnisse zu verbessern.
sentences.translation: I attend the course in order to improve my knowledge.
sentences.note: Um ... zu expresses a purpose when both clauses have the same subject.

sentences.text: Der Abschluss wird von vielen Unternehmen anerkannt.
sentences.translation: The qualification is recognized by many companies.
sentences.note: The passive focuses on the recognized qualification rather than the companies.

sentences.text: Obwohl der Kurs anspruchsvoll ist, lohnt er sich.
sentences.translation: Although the course is demanding, it is worthwhile.
sentences.note: Obwohl introduces a contrast and sends the verb to the end.

grammar.title: Expressing purpose with um ... zu
grammar.explanation: Use um ... zu plus an infinitive when the subject of the main clause also performs the purpose action. The zu infinitive appears at the end.

examples.source: Ich lerne jeden Abend, um die Prüfung zu bestehen.
examples.translation: I study every evening in order to pass the exam.

examples.source: Sie macht einen Kurs, um sich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.
examples.translation: She is taking a course to develop professionally.

grammar.commonMistake: Use damit instead when the purpose clause has a different subject.

lines.speaker: Beraterin
lines.text: Was möchten Sie mit der Weiterbildung erreichen?
lines.translation: What would you like to achieve with the further training?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.text: Ich möchte meine digitalen Kenntnisse verbessern, um mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
lines.translation: I would like to improve my digital skills in order to take on more responsibility.

lines.speaker: Beraterin
lines.text: Dann passt dieser berufsbegleitende Kurs gut. Berufserfahrung ist eine Voraussetzung.
lines.translation: Then this part-time course fits well. Professional experience is a requirement.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.text: Gut. Wird der Abschluss von Unternehmen anerkannt?
lines.translation: Good. Is the qualification recognized by companies?

questions.explanation: Eine Voraussetzung is something required before participation is possible.

questions.prompt: Ich lerne, um die Prüfung ___ bestehen.
questions.explanation: Um ... zu plus an infinitive expresses purpose with the same subject.
Voraussetzungen erfüllen means to meet requirements.
Die Weiterbildung means further or continuing training.
Um ... zu is correct because the subject stays the same.
Teilnehmen separates into nehme ... teil.
Werden plus the participle anerkannt forms the passive.

questions.prompt: What experience does the course require?
questions.explanation: The adviser says that professional experience is a prerequisite.

lessons.title: When travel plans change
lessons.summary: Understand disruption announcements, ask about alternatives, and make a complaint.
lessons.heroTitle: Stay clear and calm when the journey changes.
lessons.completionTitle: You can handle a disrupted journey.

sentences.text: Der Zug fällt wegen einer technischen Störung aus.
sentences.translation: The train is cancelled because of a technical fault.
sentences.note: Wegen introduces the reason; ausfallen separates in the main clause.

sentences.text: Könnten Sie mir sagen, wann der Ersatzbus abfährt?
sentences.translation: Could you tell me when the replacement bus leaves?
sentences.note: The verb goes to the end in the indirect question.

sentences.text: Ich habe meinen Anschluss aufgrund der Verspätung verpasst.
sentences.translation: I missed my connection due to the delay.
sentences.note: Aufgrund der Verspätung gives a formal reason.

sentences.text: Falls der nächste Zug voll ist, nehme ich den Bus.
sentences.translation: If the next train is full, I will take the bus.
sentences.note: Falls introduces a possible condition and sends the verb to the end.

sentences.text: Ich möchte wissen, ob der Fahrpreis erstattet wird.
sentences.translation: I would like to know whether the fare will be refunded.
sentences.note: Ob introduces an indirect yes-or-no question.

grammar.title: Polite indirect questions
grammar.explanation: Indirect questions make requests sound more polite. Use a question word or ob, and move the conjugated verb to the end of the subordinate clause.
grammar.pattern: Könnten Sie sagen, question word/ob + ... + verb?

examples.source: Wissen Sie, wann der Zug ankommt?
examples.translation: Do you know when the train arrives?

examples.source: Könnten Sie prüfen, ob mein Ticket gültig ist?
examples.translation: Could you check whether my ticket is valid?

grammar.commonMistake: Do not keep direct-question word order inside the indirect clause.

lines.speaker: Reisende
lines.text: Mein Zug ist ausgefallen, und ich habe den letzten Anschluss verpasst.
lines.translation: My train was cancelled, and I missed the last connection.

lines.speaker: Mitarbeiter
lines.text: Es gibt einen Ersatzbus, der in zwanzig Minuten abfährt.
lines.translation: There is a replacement bus that leaves in twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Reisende
lines.text: Könnten Sie mir sagen, ob mein Ticket dort gültig ist?
lines.translation: Could you tell me whether my ticket is valid on it?

lines.speaker: Mitarbeiter
lines.text: Ja. Falls Sie ihn nicht nehmen, können Sie eine Erstattung beantragen.
lines.translation: Yes. If you do not take it, you can request a refund.

questions.explanation: Die Verspätung means a delay.

choices: Könnten Sie sagen, wann der Bus abfährt?
Könnten Sie sagen, wann fährt der Bus ab?
questions.correctAnswer: Könnten Sie sagen, wann der Bus abfährt?
questions.explanation: The conjugated verb goes to the end of the indirect question.

questions.prompt: if the next train is full
choices: falls der nächste Zug voll ist
ob der nächste Zug voll ist
wegen der nächste Zug voll ist
questions.correctAnswer: falls der nächste Zug voll ist
questions.explanation: Falls introduces a possible condition.
Der Ersatzverkehr is transport provided when normal service is unavailable.

questions.prompt: Ich möchte wissen, ___ das Ticket gültig ist.
questions.explanation: Ob introduces an indirect yes-or-no question.
The verb belongs at the end of an indirect question.
Ausfallen means to be cancelled.

questions.prompt: What can the traveler request instead of taking the bus?
questions.explanation: The employee says the traveler can request a refund.

lessons.title: Taking part in the community
lessons.summary: Discuss local issues, volunteer, and explain how a proposal could help.
lessons.heroTitle: Make your voice useful in the community.
objectives: Present a proposal and its intended result

sentences.text: Ich engagiere mich ehrenamtlich in unserer Nachbarschaft.
sentences.translation: I volunteer in our neighborhood.
sentences.note: Sich engagieren is reflexive and commonly describes voluntary involvement.

sentences.text: Viele Bewohner beteiligen sich an dem neuen Projekt.
sentences.translation: Many residents are taking part in the new project.
sentences.note: Sich beteiligen uses an plus the dative case.

sentences.text: Wir unterstützen ältere Menschen, indem wir Einkäufe erledigen.
sentences.translation: We support older people by doing their shopping.
sentences.note: Indem explains the method used to achieve something.

sentences.text: Wir sammeln Ideen, damit alle mitentscheiden können.
sentences.translation: We collect ideas so that everyone can help decide.
sentences.note: Damit introduces an intended result with a different subject.

sentences.text: Der Vorschlag wurde nach einer langen Diskussion angenommen.
sentences.translation: The proposal was accepted after a long discussion.
sentences.note: The past passive uses wurde plus the past participle.

grammar.title: Explaining method and purpose
grammar.explanation: Use indem to explain how an action is carried out. Use damit to explain the intended result, especially when the clauses have different subjects.
grammar.pattern: result + indem + method / action + damit + intended result

examples.source: Wir sparen Energie, indem wir das Licht ausschalten.
examples.translation: We save energy by turning off the light.

examples.source: Wir informieren alle, damit niemand die Sitzung verpasst.
examples.translation: We inform everyone so that nobody misses the meeting.

grammar.commonMistake: Do not use indem for a goal; it describes the method that produces a result.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Wir möchten den Innenhof gemeinsam nutzen. Wer will sich beteiligen?
lines.translation: We would like to use the courtyard together. Who wants to get involved?

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.text: Ich helfe, indem ich Pflanzen und Werkzeug organisiere.
lines.translation: I will help by organizing plants and tools.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Wir sammeln zuerst Vorschläge, damit alle Nachbarn mitentscheiden können.
lines.translation: First we will collect proposals so that all neighbors can help decide.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.text: Gut. Dann wird das Projekt von der ganzen Nachbarschaft unterstützt.
lines.translation: Good. Then the project will be supported by the whole neighborhood.

questions.explanation: Ehrenamtlich describes unpaid work done for a community or cause.
Indem introduces the method used to help.

questions.prompt: Wir sammeln Ideen, ___ alle mitentscheiden können.
questions.explanation: Damit introduces the intended result for another subject.
Der Vorschlag means proposal or suggestion.
Indem introduces the method.
Sich beteiligen is used with an plus the dative.
Damit introduces purpose and sends the verb to the end.
Luis offers to organize plants and tools.
